publications.name: Seeing Isn't Enough: Unlocking Visual Reasoning by Bridging the Reasoning-Access Gap with TIGER
publications.summary: TIGER targets problems a model solves as text but fails to solve as rendered images, then trains on the image inputs with GRPO, with SFT and DPO as alternative objectives. Training on synthetic rendered-text images improves reasoning across real-world visual benchmarks.
